scope: Serving-owned authenticated relay and native four-player integration only; N1R-b open.

environment.kind: Wine and four separate virtual hosts on private isolated LAN
environment.outbound: No outside interface or default route
environment.NAT: None in this integration run; previous NAT/Internet evidence retains its own scope
environment.impairments: No configured latency/jitter/loss/reordering/bandwidth cap/MTU change; captured interface metadata remains local
environment.limits: Shared host kernel and virtual LAN; not new Internet/ISP/CGNAT evidence

implementation.policy: Opt-in authenticated_relay in RoomRules; keep LegacyDirect and old prototype unchanged. Phase1 default still awaits full N1R-b acceptance.
implementation.launcher: Existing private Unix launcher returns pinned certificate and one-use capability scoped to player/session generation. New kr-companion accepts private stdin only; no secret in argv/logs.
implementation.authority: Fresh account inspection before QUIC admission, channel generation/connection/visit/slot/room session+generation/round+random service identity and exact current membership before each pump. Expiry/revoke does not renew on UDP/control.
implementation.control: Reserve bounded control queues and routes before Start; companion binds snapshot and acknowledges exact routes, service waits before native153. Native bytes unchanged. Independent route128 and seq64/replay64 outside KR.
implementation.resource: One server QUIC UDP listener, bounded peers/routes/queues and per-round retirement. Client loopback endpoints quarantined until session ends with finite 26..32768 socket budget; exhaustion fails closed. Public port reused while native low-byte key repeats; internal epoch and full native key remain monotonic.
implementation.limits: No authentication of another local process, automatic companion reconnect, session/match restore, multiserver relay or NAT-direct discovery. Native8/sparse/active departure/restart/common-IP attack and M8 budgets still required.

verification.synthetic: Four rounds over two-route pool; old native endpoint/data, generation/capability/replay/owner/revoke denial and current positive. No native attack or gate closure inferred.
verification.optional_REA: TShark provider unavailable because REA_TSHARK_COMMAND is unset. No configuration change or REA packet claim. Independent retained Ethernet/TCP/UDP decoder and passive native consumers used.

reuse.current: boom-kr-server@23364d5; CP286 native loopback/unchanged UDP, CP285 account DB and CP283 current roster/consumer fixtures.
reuse.direct: Current account/room/round policies, Python independent decoder, passive KR consumers, Wine isolation/export/seal and copied-native getter.
reuse.method_only: Static foundation lab example stays diagnostic; no static capabilities/routes in serving. No VN or legacy server port.
reuse.must_compare: Native4 serving delta measured here; native8/sparse/departure and restart/spoof remain.
reuse.avoids: No N1b retry, broad peer decompile, account/profile requalification or map/item RE.

retained_failures.result: exit1 before native launch; old fixed-profile recipe seeded sessions before DatabaseZero service begin_instance invalidated them. Expected fail-closed; no native acceptance.
Initial dynamic-companion shutdown test raced stop vs control EOF; explicit stop prioritized and full 154-test rerun passed.
Wrong-root require-local checker cancelled; worktree local is external symlink. Canonical exact-head checks required before merge.
Verifier initially assumed bomb probe had round field. Retained wire/native output unchanged; corrected classification uses independent clock time brackets.

acceptance.native_four: pass in declared scope: all directed sender slots apply at each receiver over two rounds, two opposite team results/reset and third Start/clock, snapshot route reuse with repeated native low key.
acceptance.small_pool_sustained_key_reuse: partial; synthetic four rounds beyond two-route pool plus native full snapshot reclamation. Sustained service/old-current control still required.
